# Judges weigh in on legal finance disclosure


- Case law & ethics


June 19, 2024


**Andrew Cohen & Danielle Cutrona**


## Summary


Judges at a recent ILFA conference in New York recognize that mandatory disclosure of legal finance is unnecessary and would hinder the efficiency of businesses pursuing their claims.
